adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, the message origin check is `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`, which is a substring test rather than strict origin equality, so an attacker origin that is a prefix of `discourseUrl` could pass. Also `iframe.src = discourseUrl + "embed/best?..."` will produce an invalid URL when `discourseUrl` lacks a trailing `/` (e.g., `https://forum.example.comembed/best`). Both are real behavior/security/correctness issues visible in the diff.
